newsitem.title: USA: Staples plans to contest FTC ruling.
newsitem.headline: Staples plans to contest FTC ruling.

text.p: Staples Inc plans to challenge the U.S. Federal Trade Commission's rejection of its proposed merger with Office Depot Inc, a senior company executive said.
Earlier today, the commission said it had decided to seek an injunction against the deal.
Despite the decision, Staples remains committed to the deal, said Todd Krasnow, Staples' executive vice president of sales and marketing.
"We're going to vigorously contest this decision," Krasnow said.
Krasnow said he could not yet comment on what the company's next step would be, noting the company had not reviewed the commission's full ruling.
A spokesman for Office Depot was not immediately available for comment.
Shares in both companies were halted pending dissemination of news.
However, prices in both shares had already begun to move dramatically ahead of the halts, with Office Depot sliding 4-5/8 to 18 and Staples jumping 1-1/16 to 25-5/8.
